# Paired type tokens with independent context

Two unary producer tokens bind distinct method formals in an invariant binary
result. Public, package static and virtual entries retain their complete generic
contracts, including a reversed formal declaration order. Context parameters
supply no generic binding. The provider result remains opaque.

Frozen source, package-source and SDK profiles compare exact callbacks, token
references, live map mutations, returned snapshots, ignored calls, late casts,
null ordering and checked/Error identity. Independent wrong programs must fail
the observer. Original class/method identities, signatures, flags, parameter
metadata and Exceptions remain unchanged.
